{"kind": "source_excerpt", "path": "Physlib/Mathematics/VariationalCalculus/Basic.lean", "version": "v4.32.0", "text": "88: The proof uses assumption that source of `f` is finite-dimensional
89: inner-product space, so that a bump function with compact support exists via
90: `ContDiffBump.hasCompactSupport` from `Analysis.Calculus.BumpFunction.Basic`.
91: 
92: The proof is by contradiction, assume that there is `x₀` such that `f x₀ ≠ 0` then one construct
93: construct `g` test function *supported* on the neighborhood of `x₀` such that `⟪f x, g x⟫ ≥ 0`
94: and `⟪f x, g x⟫ > 0` on a neighborhood of x₀.
95: 
96: Using `Y` for the theorem below to make use of bump functions in InnerProductSpaces. `Y` is
97: a finite dimensional measurable space over `ℝ` with (standard) inner product.
98: -/
99: lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
100:     (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
101:     [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
102:     (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
103:     f = 0 := by
104:   -- assume ¬(f = 0)
105:     rw [funext_iff]; by_contra h₀
106:     obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀
107:     simp at hx0 -- hx0 : f x₀ ≠ 0
108: 
109:   -- [1] Proof that `f` is continuous at `x₀`.
110:   -- Embed into the true IP-space `WithLp 2 V`.
111:     let f₂ : Y → WithLp 2 V := toL2 ℝ ∘ f
112:     let x₂ := f₂ x₀
113:   -- x₂ ≠ 0 because `fromL2 (toL2 (f x₀)) = f x₀`
114:     have hx2 : x₂ ≠ 0 := by
115:       intro h; apply hx0; exact congrArg (fromL2 ℝ) h
116:   -- continuity of f₂ at x₀
117:     have hcont₂ : ContinuousAt f₂ x₀ := ((toL2 ℝ).continuous.comp hf).continuousAt
118: 
119:   -- [2] find open neighborhood guaranteeing positive inner product with the center, based on
120:   -- which the test function `g` will be constructed.
121:   -- pick δ₂ so that on B(x₀, δ₂), ‖f₂ x - x₂‖ < ‖x₂‖/2
122:     obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂⟩ :=
123:     Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont₂ (‖x₂‖ / 2)
124:       (by simpa [half_pos] using (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx2))
125:   -- now the usual “add & subtract” proof inside WithLp 2 V
126:     have inner_pos₂ : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂), 0 < (⟪f₂ x, x₂⟫_ℝ : ℝ) := by
127:       intros x hx
128:     -- hx : x ∈ ball x₀ δ₂, so dist x x₀ < δ₂, hence
129:     -- this is |⟪u,v⟫| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖, in the genuine InnerProductSpace on WithLp 2 V
130:       have hclose : ‖f₂ x - x₂‖ < ‖x₂‖ / 2 := by
131:         convert hδ₂ hx using 1
132:         exact mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp rfl
133:       have hself : ⟪x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ = ‖x₂‖^2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq (x₂ : WithLp 2 V)
134:       -- Cauchy–Schwarz in `WithLp 2 V` bounds the cross term from below
135:       have hcs : -(‖f₂ x - x₂‖ * ‖x₂‖) ≤ ⟪f₂ x - x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ :=
136:         neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
137:       have hxp : 0 < ‖x₂‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx2
138:       have inner_eq_self_add_diff : ⟪f₂ x, x₂⟫_ℝ = ⟪x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ + ⟪f₂ x - x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ := by
139:         rw [← inner_add_left]; simp
140:       nlinarith [inner_eq_self_add_diff, hcs, hself, hclose, hxp,
141:         mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hclose hxp]
142:   -- pull `inner_pos₂` back to V via `fromL2`:
143:     have inner_pos_V : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x hx => inner_pos₂ x hx
144:     -- now we have a genuine positive integrand on a set of positive measure.
145: 
146:   -- [3] `g` construction using bump function.
147:     have bump_exists : ∃ φ : Y → ℝ, IsTestFunction φ ∧ φ x₀ > 0 ∧
148:         (∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧
149:         Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/2) ∧
150:         (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ₂/4), 0 < φ x) := by
151:         -- use `hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace`, leveraging `[innerProductSpace Y]`
152:           haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
153:           let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ :=
154:             ⟨δ₂ / 4, δ₂ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
155:           refine ⟨φ1.toFun, ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩,
156:             φ1.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self φ1.rOut_pos), fun x _ => φ1.nonneg,
157:             by rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq], fun x hx => φ1.pos_of_mem_ball ?_⟩
158:         -- the closed ball of radius `δ₂/4` lies in the open ball of radius `rOut = δ₂/2`
159:           rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx
160:           exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hx (by show δ₂ / 4 < δ₂ / 2; linarith))
161:     obtain ⟨φ, hφ_testfun, hφ_pos_x₀, hφ_non_neg, hφ_support_subset, hφ_pos_inner⟩ :=
162:       bump_exists
163:   -- Define test function g(x) = φ(x) * f(x₀)
164:     let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
165:   -- Show that g is a test function: `φ` is a test function and `f x₀` is smooth (constant)
166:     have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const
167: 
168:   -- [4] Derive contradiction. First compute the integral ∫ ⟪f x, g x⟫
169:   -- [4.1] ∫ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ = 0
170:     have key_integral := hg g hg_test
171:   -- linearity of inner product in the second argument turns the integrand into `φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫`
172:     simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
173: 
174:   -- [4.2] 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ. Sketch: on the support of φ (which is contained in
175:   -- B(x₀, δ/2) ⊆ B(x₀, δ)), we have ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ > ‖f x₀‖²/2 > 0 by our choice of δ.
176:   -- Since φ is nonnegative on its support and positive somewhere, this gives the contradiction.
177: 
178:   -- [4.2.1] Integrability of the integrand: `integrable_prod` .
179:     have support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂ :=
180:       hφ_support_subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
181:     have supp_subset2 : Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) ⊆ Function.support φ := by
182:       intro x hprod hφ0
183:     -- if φ x = 0 then φ x * inner = 0, contradiction
184:       simp [hφ0] at hprod
185:     have hinner_cont : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
186:       Continuous.inner' (f : Y → V) (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
187:     have integrable_prod :
188:       Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
189:     -- (i) build a `HasCompactSupport` witness for the product
190:       (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hinner_cont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
191:         (hφ_testfun.supp.mono supp_subset2)
192: 
193:   -- [4.2.2] Nonnegativity everywhere (`h_nonneg`)
194:     have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
195:       intro x", "truncated": false}

12: # Test functions
13: 
14: Definition of test function, smooth and compactly supported function, and theorems about them.
15: -/
16: 
17: @[expose] public section
18: open Module
19: section IsTestFunction
20: variable
21:   {X} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
22:   {U} [NormedAddCommGroup U] [NormedSpace ℝ U]
23:   {V} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] -- [InnerProductSpace' ℝ V]

25: open ContDiff InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory
26: /-- A test function is a smooth function with compact support. -/
27: @[fun_prop]
28: structure IsTestFunction (f : X → U) where
29:   smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f
30:   supp : HasCompactSupport f
31: 
32: /-- A compactly supported continuous map from a test function. -/
33: def IsTestFunction.toCompactlySupportedContinuousMap {f : X → U}
34:     (hf : IsTestFunction f) : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X U where
35:   toFun := f
36:   hasCompactSupport' := hf.supp
37:   continuous_toFun := hf.smooth.continuous
38: 
39: lemma IsTestFunction.of_compactlySupportedContinuousMap {f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X U}
40:     (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
41:     IsTestFunction f.toFun where
42:   smooth := hf
43:   supp := f.hasCompactSupport'
44: 
45: @[fun_prop]
46: lemma IsTestFunction.integrable [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
47:     {f : X → U} (hf : IsTestFunction f)
48:     (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] :
49:     MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ :=
50:   Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (continuous hf.smooth) hf.supp
51: 
52: @[fun_prop]
53: lemma IsTestFunction.differentiable {f : X → U} (hf : IsTestFunction f) :
54:     Differentiable ℝ f := hf.1.differentiable (by simp)
55: 
56: @[fun_prop]
57: lemma IsTestFunction.contDiff {f : X → U} (hf : IsTestFunction f) :
58:     ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := hf.1
59: 
60: @[fun_prop]
61: lemma IsTestFunction.zero :
62:     IsTestFunction (fun _ : X => (0 : U)) where
63:   smooth := by fun_prop
64:   supp := HasCompactSupport.zero
65: 
66: @[fun_prop]
67: lemma IsTestFunction.comp_left {f : X → V} (hf : IsTestFunction f)
68:     {g : V → U} (hg1 : g 0 = 0) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
69:     IsTestFunction (fun x => g (f x)) where
70:   smooth := ContDiff.comp hg hf.smooth
71:   supp := by
72:     obtain ⟨K, cK, hK⟩ := exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mpr hf.supp
73:     refine exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mp ⟨K, cK, fun x hx => ?_⟩
74:     rw [hK x hx]
75:     exact hg1
76:

78: lemma IsTestFunction.pi {ι} [Fintype ι] {φ : X → ι → U} (hφ : ∀ i, IsTestFunction (φ · i)) :
79:     IsTestFunction (fun x i => φ x i) where
80:   smooth := contDiff_pi' (fun i => (hφ i).smooth)
81:   supp := by
82:     let K : ι → Set X := fun i =>
83:       Classical.choose (exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mpr (hφ i).supp)
84:     have hK (i : ι) := Classical.choose_spec (exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mpr (hφ i).supp)
85:     refine exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mp
86:       ⟨⋃ i, K i, isCompact_iUnion (fun i => (hK i).1), fun x hx => ?_⟩
87:     simp at hx
88:     conv_lhs =>
89:       enter [i]
90:       rw [(hK i).2 x (hx i)]
91:     rfl
92: 
93: lemma IsTestFunction.space_component {φ : X → Space d} (hφ : IsTestFunction φ) :
94:     IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x i) where
95:   smooth := by
96:     have hφ := hφ.smooth
97:     fun_prop
98:   supp := by
99:     obtain ⟨K, cK, hK⟩ := exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mpr hφ.supp
100:     refine exists_compact_iff_hasCompactSupport.mp ⟨K, cK, fun x hx => ?_⟩
101:     rw [hK x hx]
102:     simp
103: 
104: @[fun_prop]
105: lemma IsTestFunction.prodMk {f : X → U} {g : X → V}
106:     (hf : IsTestFunction f) (hg : IsTestFunction g) :
107:     IsTestFunction (fun x => (f x, g x)) where
108:   smooth := by fun_prop
109:   supp := by

  toFun : ℝ → E → ℝ

theorem _root_.IsClosed.measure_eq_one_iff_eq_univ [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hF : IsClosed F) :
    μ F = 1 ↔ F = univ := by
  rw [← measure_univ (μ := μ), hF.measure_eq_univ_iff_eq]

/-- A null set has empty interior. -/
theorem interior_eq_empty_of_null (hs : μ s = 0) : interior s = ∅ :=
  isOpen_interior.eq_empty_of_measure_zero <| measure_mono_null interior_subset hs

/-- A property satisfied almost everywhere is satisfied on a dense subset. -/
theorem dense_of_ae {p : X → Prop} (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x) : Dense {x | p x} := by
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq, closure_eq_compl_interior_compl, compl_univ_iff]
  exact μ.interior_eq_empty_of_null hp

/-- If two functions are a.e. equal on an open set and are continuous on this set, then they are
equal on this set. -/
theorem eqOn_open_of_ae_eq {f g : X → Y} (h : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict U] g) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hg : ContinuousOn g U) : EqOn f g U := by
  replace h := ae_imp_of_ae_restrict h
  simp only [ae_iff, Classical.not_imp] at h
  have : IsOpen (U ∩ { a | f a ≠ g a }) := by
    refine isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun a ha => inter_mem (hU.mem_nhds ha.1) ?_
    rcases ha with ⟨ha : a ∈ U, ha' : (f a, g a) ∈ (diagonal Y)ᶜ⟩
    exact
      (hf.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ha)).prodMk_nhds (hg.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ha))
        (isClosed_diagonal.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds ha')
  replace := (this.eq_empty_of_measure_zero h).le
  exact fun x hx => Classical.not_not.1 fun h => this ⟨hx, h⟩

/-- If two continuous functions are a.e. equal, then they are equal. -/
theorem eq_of_ae_eq {f g : X → Y} (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) : f = g :=
  suffices EqOn f g univ from funext fun _ => this trivial
  eqOn_open_of_ae_eq (ae_restrict_of_ae h) isOpen_univ hf.continuousOn hg.continuousOn

theorem eqOn_of_ae_eq {f g : X → Y} (h : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] g) (hf : ContinuousOn f s)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g s) (hU : s ⊆ closure (interior s)) : EqOn f g s :=
  have : interior s ⊆ s := interior_subset
  (eqOn_open_of_ae_eq (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset this h) isOpen_interior (hf.mono this)
        (hg.mono this)).of_subset_closure
    hf hg this hU

variable (μ) in
theorem _root_.Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq {f g : X → Y} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    f =ᵐ[μ] g ↔ f = g :=
  ⟨fun h => eq_of_ae_eq h hf hg, fun h => h ▸ EventuallyEq.rfl⟩

theorem _root_.Continuous.isOpenPosMeasure_map [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    {Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} (hf : Continuous f) (hf_surj : Function.Surjective f) :
    (Measure.map f μ).IsOpenPosMeasure := by
  refine ⟨fun U hUo hUne => ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply hf.measurable hUo.measurableSet]
